structure_review.rationale: The four-membered core, two exocyclic diphenylmethylene groups and two directly attached phenyl groups agree with Chart 1. The RDKit drawing has overlapping phenyls, which are not extra bonds.
structure_review.limitations: Assistant visual comparison with the source figure, not independent chemical identity certification. No supplementary structure file or expert approval is claimed.
